title: raceGPS Citypack Manifest (Dialect A: flat file references)
description: Schema for <city_id>_semantic_manifest.json, derived from the real artifact citypacks/akron-oh-beta-001/akron_semantic_manifest.json. See docs/CITYPACK_CONTRACT.md. Additive-only: additional properties are allowed; never remove or retype existing keys without a major version bump.

city_id.description: Unique pack identifier; also the citypack directory name. Example: akron-oh-beta-001

display_name.description: Human-readable city name. Read by UE5 MainMenuWidget.

version.description: Pack semver. UE5 compares major.minor against the game build (CruiseSprintGameMode::IsVersionCompatible).

game_version_min.description: Declared minimum compatible game version. Currently not read by any consumer.

game_version_max.description: Declared maximum compatible game version. Currently not read by any consumer.

origin.description: WGS84 world origin used for geo->world projection (StreetFurnitureSpawner, generate-level-spec.py).

bounds.description: WGS84 bounding box of the compiled area. NOTE: AkronXodrImporter::LoadManifest reads lat_min/lon_min instead; see CITYPACK_CONTRACT.md section 7 item 3.

opendrive_file.description: OpenDRIVE file, relative to the pack directory.

routes.description: Routes JSON (bare array), relative to the pack directory.

road_graph.description: Semantic road graph JSON, relative to the pack directory.

spawn_points.description: Spawn points JSON (bare array), relative to the pack directory.

pois.description: Classified POIs JSON (bare array), relative to the pack directory.

buildings.description: Buildings JSON, relative to the pack directory. Optional; the file may be absent even when referenced (see CITYPACK_CONTRACT.md section 7 item 2).

gameplay_layer.description: Gameplay layer JSON (speed/pickup/objective/challenge zones). Optional; Akron-only at present.
